capabilities: Export a note as .md or .txt to a folder outside the vault
Export the selected text in the editor as .md or .txt
Trigger exports from right-click menus, the command palette, or hotkeys
Configure the export folder, save dialog, timestamp format, and clipboard copying
Sanitize generated file names with timestamps
extras: Desktop only, because it relies on Node filesystem APIs. The README documents safety guarantees (read-only on the vault, single fs.writeFile) and notes the export folder must already exist. Pre-release manual installation does not auto-update.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to quickly write a copy of a note or a selection to a file outside the vault without manually locating and copying it.
summary: Export plugin that saves a copy of a note or a text selection to a folder outside the vault as .md or .txt via right-click menus, commands or hotkeys.
